player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in JoJoJoin, played on a 5x5 board with cells numbered 0-24.
On your turn, place your mark on any empty cell, e.g. '[12]'.
YOU WIN by getting FOUR of your marks in a row — four consecutive cells horizontally, vertically, or diagonally.
As Player {player_id} you are '{symbol}'; your opponent is '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A yeke na lege ni pëpe ti sû tënë so a hunda.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ayeke mbeni ye so alingbi na ndia pëpe. A lingbi a duti na popo ti 0 nga 24.
invalid_move.already_occupied: A zia mbeni tënë na yâ ti cellule {cell} awe.

outcome.draw: A sara match ni na lege ti kpongo zo oko pëpe!
